lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima arranged in five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, showing a staggered spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of diffused pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where blobs serve as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient, representing structural longitudinal ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: Two yellow pilot fish (Gnathanodon speciosus) visible in the ventral-anterior region, one positioned below the pectoral fin and one below the third/fourth gill slit.
